808.title: Shrek
808.overview: It ain't easy bein' green -- especially if you're a likable (albeit smelly) ogre named Shrek. On a mission to retrieve a gorgeous princess from the clutches of a fire-breathing dragon, Shrek teams up with an unlikely compatriot -- a wisecracking donkey.

15080.title: Only Yesterday
15080.overview: In lyrical switches between the present and the past, Taeko contemplates the arc of her life, and wonders if she has been true to the dreams of her childhood self.

164328.title: The Strange Little Cat
164328.overview: It is a Saturday in autumn, and Karin and Simon are visiting their parents and youngest sister Clara. This family gathering provides the occasion for a dinner together, at which other relatives appear over the course of the day. While the family members animate the apartment’s space with their conversations, everyday activities and cooking preparations, the cat and dog range through the various rooms. they too become a central element in this quotidian familial dance that repeatedly manifests stylized elements, disrupting any naturalistic mode of presentation. In this way, adjoining spaces open up between family drama, fairy tale and the psychological study of a mother.

588520.title: Children of Liberty
588520.overview: New York, 1941. When his father mysteriously vanishes at Grand Central, a boy and his new friend must navigate a city crawling with spies to find him and uncover a conspiracy that's bigger than either of them imagined.

588648.title: Dragonkeeper
588648.overview: Set in Han Imperial China, the plot follows the adventures of enslaved girl Ping with ancient dragon Long Danzi. Dragons had been banished from the kingdom. Ping, an orphan, finds one of the last remaining dragon eggs. Palace guards force Ping to run away in order to return the dragon egg to the ocean and save all dragons from extinction. Ping discovers that she is a true Dragonkeeper.

890216.title: Pacific
890216.overview: A group of young travelers are stranded on an island in the Pacific where they struggle to escape an evil presence kept hidden from mankind for centuries.
890216.trailerName: PACIFICO (2026) a film by Gonzalo Gutierrez - Theatrical Teaser

999592.title: Rise of the Empire
999592.overview: Upon returning home from his Grand Embassy, Peter the Great enters into a prolonged war with Sweden to secure access to the Baltic Sea. His path to victory is paved with setbacks, treachery, and deceit. Only by overcoming these challenges will he become Emperor, find true love, and establish Russia as a great empire.

1049064.title: Mahendragiri Varahi
1049064.overview: Siddharth, an atheist and skeptic, is drawn into a mysterious journey surrounding the ancient Varahi temple at Mahendragiri. As he uncovers secrets connected to the sacred site, he is forced to confront forces beyond his understanding, challenging his beliefs and changing his perception of faith, destiny, and the supernatural.
1049064.trailerName: Mahendragiri Varahi - Teaser | Sumanth | Meenakshi Goswami | Aishwarya Rajesh | Anup Rubens

1083624.title: Ugly Duckling Ms. Maeng
1083624.overview: Ms. Maeng, a small-town teacher, unexpectedly joins the team responsible for creating South Korea’s most important exam: the College Scholastic Ability Test. She thought it would be all about academic prestige and scholarly debate but instead finds herself locked away under spy-level security, her phone confiscated and surrounded by office politics. Can this unlikely underdog turn test stress into test success, or just test everyone's patience?

1146344.title: Misdirection
1146344.overview: A desperate couple have pulled off a string of high-end break-ins to pay off a mob debt. When they attempt to rob their latest victim, they find themselves caught in a deadly game of cat and mouse. The tables are turned and the hunters become the hunted.

1153576.title: Street Fighter
1153576.overview: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

1160360.title: If I Had Legs I'd Kick You
1160360.overview: With her life crashing down around her, Linda attempts to navigate her child's mysterious illness, her absent husband, a missing person, and an increasingly hostile relationship with her therapist.
1160360.original_title: If I Had Legs I'd Kick You

1170600.title: Return of the Living Dead
1170600.overview: Eighteen months after the events at the UNEEDA Warehouse in Louisville, KY, a new Trioxin 2-4-5 leak puts a small Pennsylvania town on the brink of a zombie outbreak during Christmas 1985.
1170600.trailerName: Exclusive RETURN OF THE LIVING DEAD mini-clip

1207016.title: The Experiencers: Full Disclosure
1207016.overview: An astonishing award-winning documentary that goes beyond asking whether extraterrestrial contact is real - and into the more unsettling question of why, drawing on firsthand accounts and evidence for what intelligent life beyond our world may be.
1207016.trailerName: The Experiencers: Full Disclosure I Official Trailer With Intro

1235304.title: Colours of Time
1235304.overview: When four distant cousins inherit a 19th-century home in Normandy, they decide to visit and examine their family history. No one has lived there since the 1940s, and the cousins are intrigued by all of the items they find there, little things that help them to understand their ancestor, Adèle Vermillard. Jumping back and forth in time, they meet the mysterious Adèle, whose bohemian lifestyle, and her relationships with the leading artists of the time, changes their lives.

1256616.title: Criaturas – Uma Aventura entre Dois Mundos
1256616.overview: Stela is twelve years old and only believes in what she can see, or not at all. Miguel, the youngest brother, believes in everything, especially in what doesn't exist. Two years after the tragic dive that killed their mother, they return to the mythical city of Paraty, where nothing is what it seems.
1256616.original_title: Criaturas – Uma Aventura entre Dois Mundos

1261032.title: Butterfly
1261032.overview: Two sisters raised on a charter resort in Gran Canaria. After 27 years, they reluctantly return to their childhood island to deal with their parents death, and end up with a half-finished esoteric retreat center in the Canary Islands.
1261032.trailerName: BUTTERFLY - Official HD Trailer - Only In Cinemas

1282280.title: Dog of God
1282280.overview: In a 17th century Swedish Livonian village, constant rain and drunkenness prevail. When a stolen relic sparks witchcraft accusations, an 80-year-old self-proclaimed werewolf named the Dog of God arrives with a mysterious gift: The Devil’s Balls.

1290792.title: One Spoon of Chocolate
1290792.overview: After serving his country in the Army, Unique is falsely accused of assault and sent to prison. Once released, Unique sets up shop in Ohio to restart his life, linking up with his only surviving relative, Ramsey. There’s something insidious happening in this town, though, as its racist sheriff and his crew of similarly bigoted acolytes all have a knack for violence and share a gruesome secret pertaining to a recent string of missing young Black men. When they set their sights on Unique and turn his life upside down, the former soldier has no choice but to bring the ruckus down on the sheriff and his goons.
1290792.trailerName: One Spoon of Chocolate | Trailer | RZA, Shameik Moore

1293352.title: GORA 4 GORA
1293352.overview: Arif, Ceku and their child Kemo return to the planet Gora. Ceku has become the queen of the planet following the death of Amir Tocha. Kemo has graduated from the Gora Military Academy. The film, which begins with Kemo's oath-taking ceremony, concludes the story that began 25 years earlier in Gora, in Gora itself.

1300968.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
1300968.overview: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.
1300968.original_title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping

1303336.title: Into The Mortal World
1303336.overview: The classic legend is adapted, and the descendants of the Cowherd and the Weaving Maiden continue to write a new adventure!  The twenty-eight star constellations contain the power of the stars, which can destroy the sky and the earth. However, the Weaving Maiden, who is in charge of the Starry Nights, is greedy for the mortal world, causing the Starry Nights to flee and causing trouble. Years later, the Weaving Maiden's son, Jin Feng, went down to the world for his mother, and teamed up with a young girl, Xiaofan, to subdue the Starry Nights. People and gods together, all the way to the thrills and dangers, the mystery of Xiaofan's life, the truth of the Weaving Maiden's crime also gradually surfaced .....

1310568.title: Murder at the Embassy
1310568.overview: 1934. Private detective Miranda Green investigates a murder perpetrated in the British Embassy in Cairo, where a top secret document was stolen, risking to jeopardize both Buckingham Palace and the peace of the world. All those present in this closed place are suspected: the American photographer, the English student, the American actress, the Egyptian security guard, the ambassador interpreter, the Egyptian gardener and - why not? — the Ambassador himself. But who would have expected that a small group of Nazis would be behind a plot, risking to jeopardize both Buckingham Palace and the peace of the world?

1317672.title: Love Me Love Me
1317672.overview: After her brother's death, June moves to Milan for a fresh start, finding comfort in Will, the perfect honor student at her new international school. But when his troubled best friend James—hiding a dangerous life in clandestine MMA fights—sparks a rivalry that quickly turns into irresistible attraction, June must choose between safety and a love that upends everything she thought she wanted.

1336808.title: That Friend
1336808.overview: Paul, “That Friend” who turns one drink into a full-blown bender, crashes his best friend Henry’s romantic weekend with his new girlfriend Penny, only to unleash chaos when his drug-laced cigarettes disappear into a stranger's hands.

1355496.title: By Design
1355496.overview: A woman swaps bodies with a chair, and everyone likes her better as a chair.
1355496.trailerName: BY DESIGN | Official Trailer | In Select Theaters February 13

1365928.title: Teaching Practice: Idiot Girls and School Ghost 2
1365928.overview: Student teacher Kang Eun-kyung encounters a group of girls in a black magic club who are topping the national mock exams.

1373800.title: The Hole
1373800.overview: Cassandra is a middle-aged mother and author whose muted life is given a new focus and her marriage is upended when she discovers a bottomless hole in her basement.

1384040.title: Haunted Heist
1384040.overview: Four estranged friends reunite at what appears to be a typical house, But one friend has ulterior motives; he plans to rob the place and needs their help to find an antique worth a fortune. But the house is straight up haunted, and the group must squash their differences to survive the night and an insane pack of ghosts.
1384040.trailerName: Haunted Heist | Official Trailer | Horror Brains

1400936.title: ...And Out Comes the Wolf
1400936.overview: Set against the East Bay punk music scene in the mid 1990s, a story of grit and dreams in a world of violence and desperation.
1400936.trailerName: And Out Comes The Wolf - Trailer

1401832.title: Ketticè
1401832.overview: Palermo, 2012. Giulio, a listless and dissatisfied 16-year-old, drifts through his days with no enthusiasm for school and no prospects for the future. His encounter with Ketty, a more self-assured peer, offers him an escape from the monotony.

1402984.title: I Blew Out the Candles Before Making a Wish
1402984.overview: Young Jojo suddenly comes into a stack of casino chips worth a million and decides to pay off her runaway father’s debt, asking the down-on-his-luck debt collector Hua to gamble on her behalf. In Macau’s chaotic casinos, they form an unlikely alliance, navigating wins, losses, and life’s challenges together. When the final bet arrives, fate cruelly tests them, stripping them of everything, yet revealing the true gift life has been offering. I Blew Out the Candle Before Making a Wish explores money, family, and responsibility, capturing the shadows and resilience of human nature.

1422120.title: Mermaid
1422120.overview: A Percocet-addicted 'Florida Man' finds a wounded mermaid at his lowest point. Fascination becomes a drug-infused, one-sided relationship—sending him further into decline. When word spreads about his secret, he’ll stop at nothing to protect her.

1426728.title: Taco Tuesday
1426728.overview: A suburban housewife embarks on a dangerous mission to rescue her captured husband so he isn't late for dinner.
1426728.trailerName: Taco Tuesday (Short Action Film) | Official Trailer

1446824.title: Moses the Black
1446824.overview: A gangster in modern day Chicago, inspired by the repentance story of the fourth-century saint of the same name.
1446824.trailerName: MOSES THE BLACK Official Trailer (2026) Wiz Khalifa, Quavo

1451944.title: Lust Stories 3
1451944.overview: Through four bite-sized yet emotionally resonant films, the anthology once again explores lust, love, relationships, and repressed desire, offering fresh perspectives on intimacy, longing, and human connection in all their complexity.

1453224.title: Breaking Al
1453224.overview: Come back and revisit Anchor Bay's Better Call Al and Breaking Broadcast in one full experience. This is an abridged/parody PG version of Better Call Saul and Breaking Bad.

1462184.title: She Keeps Me Young
1462184.overview: Michelle is floating through life until a surprising connection with a high schooler challenges her friendship with her overbearing best friend, in this bitingly astute and exceptionally hilarious satire.

1477480.title: Steamboat Killie
1477480.overview: A small town is shaken when a series of brutal murders begins, all linked by one disturbing detail: the killer is dressed in a Mickey Mouse costume. As the body count rises, a group of locals races to uncover who's behind the mask before the killer strikes again.

1480424.title: Karla
1480424.overview: Twelve-year-old Karla testifies in court. She makes serious accusations against her own father, who should have guaranteed her safety. Judge Lamy supports her in this difficult trial and becomes her most important confidant.

1492328.title: The Designer is Dead
1492328.overview: The Designer Is Dead follows Miguel Adrover, the groundbreaking New York designer who reshaped fashion with bold statements on multiculturalism, sustainability, and politics. Once hailed as the future of fashion, he faded from the spotlight and sought new inspiration in Mallorca. The documentary revisits his rise, fall, and creative rebirth through rare archival material, unseen shows, and interviews with collaborators like Jennifer Hoffman and Pulitzer-winning critic Robin Givhan.

1511400.title: Alphabet Lane
1511400.overview: An isolated couple lose control of a joke about imaginary friends.
1511400.trailerName: Alphabet Lane trailer | In cinemas 23 April 2026 | Film and Culture. Not content.

1516456.title: Ghost School
1516456.overview: Rabia, a ten-year-old Pakistani girl sets out to find why her only school in the village is closed. This fable is a ghost story with a tinge of magical-realism that explores corruption from a child's perspective.

1519016.title: Forty Love
1519016.overview: Sacha Gallo, a tennis prodigy, has been training with his father to win a major trophy in Paris. But the arrival of a charismatic new rival challenges everything Sacha thought he understood about competition, ambition, and himself.

1522664.title: Oko
1522664.overview: Strange images hide in my mother's photo album, snapshots of her youth in Russia inside a colorful yoga club. Today, she devotes herself to other cults, all of which bring their share of propaganda, rites, gurus, and of course sacrifices. I play her role, to understand or to exorcize.

1522856.title: Karlovy Vary
1522856.overview: Karlovy Vary is a beautiful city located in the western Czech Republic. Sung-Jae, the director of the film, completed the script with Karlovy Vary in mind, and his work received awards for various contests and even got investment for the film production! Sung-Jae accomplished everything he dreamed of at once. After finishing filming on the domestic set, now he only has to film in Karlovy Vary. However… all the invested production money is gone! In order not to cough up the money, Sung-Jae has to finish the movie no matter what! Will Sung-Jae and his friends be able to finish the movie without going to Karlovy Vary?

1523368.title: The Beginning of Her Reign
1523368.overview: A successful businessman longs for female domination. His secretary becomes his partner in a daring journey of love, power, and self-discovery, challenging societal norms and personal boundaries.

1524008.title: Draniki
1524008.overview: Max, an ordinary schoolboy with somewhat unusual parents, finds himself in a village for winter break, against his will. In the village, he encounters a dish that's familiar to the locals but new to him - potato pancakes. The boys, along with their cousin, decide to start a business: they convert an old UAZ into a food truck and sell potato pancakes. But how can you tackle adult problems when you're still a child yourself?

1532008.title: Will You Care If I Die?
1532008.overview: When youth worker Nic crosses paths with Elijah, a troubled teenager with undeniable basketball talent, he sees more than just a boy in need of help. Determined to steer him away from a destructive path, Nic takes Elijah under his wing, risking personal and professional boundaries to help him realize his potential both on and off the court. Against all rules and without anyone else's knowledge, Nic offers Elijah to move in with him. This marks the beginning of a close relationship, and the encounter with Elijah also helps Nic gain a deeper understanding of himself.
1532008.original_title: Blir du ledsen om jag dör?

1532968.title: Pa Pa Go
1532968.overview: Influencer Bunny struggles to stand out online when her ex-gangster father, Tian, is released from prison. Their reunion sparks conflict as he’s urged to rejoin the triad while she defends her career. Tian’s accidental viral fame fuels jealousy from his ambitious underling, triggering gang turmoil and exposing Bunny’s family ties. As her public image collapses, father and daughter must confront their past and choose between power, pride, and love—learning that redemption and understanding are the only way to truly move forward.

1558568.title: Go Team!
1558568.overview: When their team-building event gets downgraded to a tiny village, a cheese company's staff think it can't get worse — then they learn about the layoffs.

1565800.title: White Haired Witch's Blood Phoenix
1565800.overview: Adapted from the novel series “Baifa Monü Zhuan” by Liang Yu Sheng.

1578152.title: Ketok Mejik
1578152.overview: Ben, a grandson who is 'forced' to inherit his grandfather's "Ketok Magic" workshop. However, this inheritance comes with a series of problems that will confuse the entire village!

1579624.title: Iconoclast
1579624.overview: A reclusive young man's dangerous obsession with a live-streaming influencer increasingly erodes his grip on reality.

1589288.title: UFC 324: Gaethje vs. Pimblett
1589288.overview: UFC 324: Gaethje vs. Pimblett was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on January 24, 2026, at the T-Mobile Arena in Paradise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Valley, United States.
1589288.trailerName: UFC 324: Gaethje vs Pimblett - January 24th | Fight Promo

1590568.title: Girl Hell
1590568.overview: Upcoming Found Footage Short Film from Lucille Hanson. Plot TBA

1595368.title: Popeye II: Returns
1595368.overview: Sequel to Popeye's Revenge (2025). A military experiment goes catastrophically wrong when a test subject escapes after receiving an experimental enhancement serum. Now supercharged with deadly abilities, he descends upon an unsuspecting summer camp with violent intent.

1596008.title: Con City
1596008.overview: Follows a struggling family whose lives change when a receipt printer starts generating money after a lightning strike, leading to public chaos when society discovers the money-making machine.
1596008.trailerName: Con City | Official Trailer | Arjun Das | Anna Ben | Yogi Babu | Netflix India

1596392.title: Lou's Team: The Story of the Humboldt Crabs
1596392.overview: Nestled in the redwood forest of Northern California, the Humboldt Crabs, founded in 1945, are the oldest continuously operated summer collegiate baseball team, with their own band, ardent fans, and tradition of winning.
1596392.trailerName: Lou's Team: The Story of the Humboldt Crabs | Official Trailer

1599784.title: Prosecution
1599784.overview: After surviving a racist attack, state prosecutor Seyo Kim takes her own case to court – confronting both the perpetrators and a justice system that turns a blind eye to right-wing extremism.

1600168.title: Home
1600168.overview: In the hope of creating a better life, 6-year-old Maja and her parents leave Yugoslavia for Denmark, leaving behind Maja’s two older brothers with the promise they will join once the family is settled. But the new country proves difficult and unfamiliar, and the family struggles to adapt to a new language, culture, and way of life. As the years pass, Maja grows up and becomes a successful artist in Denmark, yet beneath her achievements, she carries a divide of joy, sorrow, and gratitude—torn between the life she has built and the painful sacrifices her parents made for their future.

1601704.title: Hasut
1601704.overview: In the wake of their parents' tragic decease, a young woman orchestrates a remote wilderness expedition to rehabilitate her estranged sister, only for the group to be terrorized by manipulative supernatural entities exploiting their communication devices.
1601704.trailerName: INCITED - Official Trailer | Karina Salim, Rachel Amanda, Marthino Lio, Kevin Ardilova

1604264.title: Rakkasapuradhol
1604264.overview: Inspector Shiva an alcoholic officer struggling with schizophrenia, is transferred to Rakkasapura, a seemingly quiet village with a low crime rate. Soon The village’s peace is shattered by a series of gruesome murders. Young women are found dead, dressed in bridal finery with their faces charred beyond recognition. Witness as a troubled cop in rural India confronts his own demons while pursuing a complex case that tests his moral boundaries and beliefs.
1604264.trailerName: Rakkasapuradhol Official Trailer | Raj B Shetty | Ravi Saranga | Dr K Raviverma | Arjun Janya

1608616.title: Because of Cupid
1608616.overview: Best friends Naomi and Marcus participate in a Valentine's Day mocktail competition but things go awry when Cupid interferes with a love potion that affects Marcus and several of their friends.
1608616.trailerName: Sneak Peek | Because of Cupid | Starring Amy Groening and Evan Roderick

1610088.title: We'll Keep It Down
1610088.overview: A dumb late-night garage hangout fueled by loud music and too much smoking gets interrupted by a noise complaint. Tensions rise, paranoia sets in, and before anyone knows what's happening, the night turns ugly in ways no one saw coming.
1610088.trailerName: We'll Keep It Down | Official Teaser Trailer

1616936.title: AURORA: What Happened to the Earth? Live From Mexico City
1616936.overview: Norwegian alt-pop artist AURORA plays her biggest ever headline performance at Mexico City’s Palacio de los Deportes as part of her What Happened to the Earth? Tour. Filmed live on Dia De Los Muertos (Day of the Dead), the arena is transformed into a space of spellbinding sound and light, and filled with fans in festive dress. AURORA’s ethereal voice is ever-captivating as she sings haunting ballads including 'Dreams' and 'Exist for Love' as well as fan-favourites 'Runaway', 'The Seed' and 'Churchyard'. Known for blending electronic pop with folk and vivid storytelling, AURORA’s performances are always immersive and emotional, and this concert – celebrating nature and the human experience – solidifies her as a beacon of originality and inspiration.
1616936.trailerName: AURORA: What Happened To The Earth? (Full Length Trailer)

1619816.title: Hamesha Deir Kardeta Hun
1619816.overview: A man rushing to the hospital becomes trapped in a stalled elevator with a stranger, where an unexpected conversation forces him to confront buried regrets until a devastating revelation reshapes everything he thought he knew.

1620584.title: Kuncen
1620584.overview: Darus (62) is a river guardian. He practices rituals and adheres to beliefs as a form of reciprocity with nature. One day, Darus hears news of a child missing in the river and is asked by the community to help with the search. However, his advancing age and an increasingly toxic relationship with the river have left him unable to go near it, to the point of causing him distress. Darus is trapped in a dilemma: saving the missing child or protecting himself.

1627624.title: Last Call
1627624.overview: New Year’s Eve 1999, Athens: a desperate fugitive armed with a live grenade takes a family hostage and demands to go on live TV as the world counts down to the new millennium. Broadcast in real time, the situation pulls in a young journalist, media executives and a divided police force, as an entire nation watches events spiral toward a tragic and irreversible outcome.

1629352.title: Same Same But Different
1629352.overview: An Iranian immigrant agrees to marry her boss's son to stay in the U.S., but their simple green card wedding on Cape Cod gets complicated when her two Iranian best friends arrive with their own American boyfriends and cross-cultural baggage in tow.

1630440.title: Bad Voodoo
1630440.overview: Two escaped convicts break into a house and take a hostage, only to discover that the hideout houses something far more dangerous: a voodoo curse born from a grieving couple’s thirst for vengeance. As the night spirals into terror, they must battle an unseen power that feeds on guilt, blood, and lost souls.

ads.name: Amazon Prime Video Free with Ads

1630504.title: The Last Picture Shows
1630504.overview: Ten states. 10,825 miles. 123 theaters. In his latest feature The Last Picture Shows, filmmaker Rustin Thompson journeys into the American West on a search for traces of what was once a center of small-town life: the movie theater. On the trip, he finds long abandoned and forgotten cinemas; movie houses that have fallen into disrepair; theaters recently closed, theaters struggling to hold on, and theaters that—thanks to their thoughtful caretakers—are not only surviving but thriving. Between the stops along the way, Rustin poetically intersperses excerpts from Peter Bogdanovich’s 1971 classic film The Last Picture Show, as well as reflections on past and present hardships facing the film exhibition industry. The Last Picture Shows reminds viewers that even in vast cinema deserts, there are oases of community and gathering that remain, where the movie house continues to be a place of wonder, contemplation, and connection.

1631208.title: Sunset Strip Killers
1631208.overview: Based on a true story, in 1980s Los Angeles, nurse Carol Bundy falls for the charming but deadly Doug Clark. Drawn into his world of murder, obsession, and blood, she becomes complicit in shocking crimes across the city.

1632808.title: Do Not Open
1632808.overview: A married couple in their 50's retreat to a secluded vacation cabin, hoping to mend their strained relationship. From the moment they arrive, they are given one rule: the door at the end of the hall is strictly off-limits. At first, the husband is mildly curious, but as the days pass, the door seems to call to him. Strange occurrences-whispers in the night, fleeting shadows, objects not where they were left-slowly unravel his sanity. His curiosity festers into obsession, consuming his every thought. What lies beyond the door? The answer may be far more terrifying than he ever imagined.

1643176.title: + Add Friend
1643176.overview: A working man must confront his secret shame as his online activity unravels into his personal life- following an intimate encounter with an anonymous internet user.

1643560.title: The Day I Smoked a Cigarette with My Father
1643560.overview: Cairo, 1964. Alaa, a 12-year-old boy, and his three younger siblings hear shouting from the street. Outside, the crowd is cheering for a man. The children can barely believe their eyes: the man is their father, Ibrahim.

1649384.title: Against The Skin
1649384.overview: In a world driven by inherited beliefs, social noise, and quiet despair, a searching mind wrestles with the question of purpose, challenging whether humanity is truly living or simply surviving until it disappears.

1649576.title: Kashmir 1947
1649576.overview: Kashmir 1947 vividly recounts the tumultuous events of 1947–48, drawing on firsthand testimonies, military perspectives, seldom-seen archives, and a captivating narrative. The documentary weaves together music, songs, and potent narration, presenting history in a way that resonates with modern viewers, even those of a younger generation.  "Kashmir 1947" is a documentary that educates, resonates, and stirs the soul. The film transforms history, crafting a compelling narrative that resonates with contemporary audiences.

1650856.title: Dastaar
1650856.overview: A Sikh immigrant rises from newcomer to community leader following a devastating racist attack.
1650856.trailerName: DASTAAR : TARSEM JASSAR (Official Teaser) | Upcoming Punjabi Movie | In Cinema on 17th July

1651304.title: Kissa Court Kachahari Ka
1651304.overview: Ditching traditional melodrama for raw grit, the story offers an authentic dive into the Indian judicial system. Set within the corridors of a district court, it highlights the human cost of bureaucracy and the grueling struggle for justice through a stark, realistic lens.
1651304.trailerName: Kissa Court Kachehari Ka - Trailer | Rajesh Sharma, Brijendra Kala, Rajnish Jaiswal | 13 March

1655912.title: Mandarinia is a Wonderland
1655912.overview: Mashenka's grandmother tells her a fairy tale about a magical land where tangerines grow that grant wishes. Dreaming only of her mother's recovery and return home, the girl sets out in search of the magic tangerine. But the fulfillment of wishes is under threat all over the world, as an evil minister is poisoning the magic tangerines.

1670376.title: Rewind Barcelona
1670376.overview: Hascoët, Émile, Léo, and Paul are a rowdy group of teenage skateboarders. They pile into Léo’s mom’s car and drive to Barcelona, the mecca of skateboarding, for their first trip away as almost-adults. They live on vacuum-sealed tortillas, drink warm cans of Lemon Damm, and spend their days and nights at MACBA. The beach might as well not exist, and the Sagrada Família is just something they pass on the way. All that matters is skating, drifting through the city, and burning through those first fragile days of freedom. Ten years later, they try to piece it back together over a few scattered phone calls. The memories are still there, but something has shifted. What once felt infinite now comes back in fragments.

1673256.title: The Genesis Project
1673256.overview: For their term project, five psychology students decide to study serial killers to learn what turns a normal person, into a cold-blooded murderer. With the knowledge they gain, they attempt to capture the killer stalking their town.

1673320.title: Jawaak
1673320.overview: Set against a community backdrop, events unfold around personal conflict and shifting relationships. As tensions rise, individuals are forced to confront difficult choices. The outcome is shaped by loyalty, pressure, and consequence.
1673320.trailerName: Jawaak (Official Trailer) | Neeru Bajwa | New Punjabi Movie 2026 | In Cinemas 8th May 2026

1677160.title: The Idiot

As if without making any promises, they suddenly find themselves in situations where it seems that the only way out is to escape.  Emil, who seems to have been given everything in life, continues to disappoint his father and overcomes all the limits of suffering. Now he is faced with a life where he has to take responsibility for everything himself. He meets Rene, from whom Emil decides that he wants to learn a lot. Rene, however, tries to keep him away from mistakes that he can no longer fix himself, but he cannot remain confident enough.  Everything starts to develop too quickly and, despite Rene's warnings, Emil ends up turning the situation against both of them. They still have to work together to find a solution. Fear has overcome the boys.

1697320.title: The Last Laugh: Stephen Colbert
1697320.overview: For more than a decade, Stephen Colbert has sat at the center of late night, where comedy, politics and culture collide. As he prepares to take the desk for the final time, The Last Laugh turns its lens on both the show and the man, exploring what audiences stand to lose when one of satire’s sharpest and most thoughtful voices signs off. The hour also examines the broader cultural and political forces surrounding the end of Colbert’s late-night run and the future of outspoken comedy in an evolving landscape.  Anchoring the hour is a dynamic lineup of interviewees spanning comedy, journalism and cultural criticism. The special features appearances from CNN Anchor and Chief Washington Correspondent Jake Tapper and comedians Jordan Carlos and Gianmarco Soresi, alongside key creative voices from The Colbert Report including Allison Silverman and Richard Dahm, each offering insight into the scope and lasting influence of Colbert’s work.

1760488.title: Бэркэ

Recently, popular ethnobloggers have emerged here, sharing stories of Tungus culture with hundreds of thousands of followers online. Timofey Ivanovich is over sixty. He is a wolf hunter, and so he adopted the online pseudonym Berke (Evenk for "wolf"). Berke is an old-timer, a keeper of traditions, respected and called upon at crucial moments. Now such a moment has arrived: the wolves have returned. Hungry packs are crushing reindeer and moving toward the village. Berke ventures alone into the taiga to drive off the predators. In his real world, he has only a rifle and a video camera. And in his virtual world, there are millions of views and thousands of comments. This is the story of how a keeper of national myths saves his small people from the scourge of wolves, and ultimately becomes a new folk legend himself.
